summary: This document records the Iceberg Spark integration updates, covering new features such as DSv2 validation, geometry bounds in Parquet writers, and runtime filtering improvements, along with bug fixes for ORC variant handling and vectorized reads. The discussion explores how the current deterministic flag in the UDF spec is too vague for cross‑engine consistency, especially for check constraints, stats‑only fields, and derived columns. The discussion centers on adding a stream-from-snapshot option to Spark streaming reads, allowing an initial full snapshot load before incremental processing. The thread proposes a biweekly 30‑minute UDF sync to accelerate implementation and reviews, with an open Google Meet link and recorded sessions.
